title: Webb spotlights gravitational arcs in 'El Gordo' galaxy cluster (NIRCam image)

evidence.locator: 4422 x 4421 px; Webb NIRCam, six filters from 1.15 to 4.4 µm, the shortest wavelengths blue and the longest red. The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.03001 arcsec per pixel, north 5.2° right of vertical, the frame's centre at 15.7306709°, -49.2603915°. Not measured against Gaia here; the same publishers' tags were within 0.4 arcsec on four cluster pictures and 1.5 arcsec off on one deep field.
